name: Quality rating
pick: A viewing test: people watch each video clip (for example from several codecs or generators) and rate it on a scale: quality, smoothness, realism.
summary: Watch clips and rate their quality, from 1 to 5.
suggest: They must watch to the end

examples.question: How smooth is the motion in this clip?

settings.title: How good is the video?
settings.instructions: Watch each clip to the end, then rate its quality: sharpness, smooth motion, and anything that looks wrong.
settings.question: How good is the quality of this video?
